steps.content: The shock takes time to sink. After a few seconds of silence, some instantly accept the invitation to the paradise's revelry, while others remain cautious, shy, and dare not step forward.
The blue-haired girl looks at those who dare not join in, her eyes darting around before she approaches a guest.

steps.speaker: Skinny Office Worker
steps.content: Ahhh...

With a gentle push from the blue-haired girl, a slender office worker in a suit falls into the water. His exclamation attracts the attention of many on the beach, who crane their necks to see what the island owner will do to him.

The fallen guest's clothes are soaked by the waves, his face turning red as he nervously covers his chest through the wet suit shirt. L.L. doesn't force him, cheerfully takes his tie, slowly pulls it off, and throws it into the waves.

steps.speaker: Skinny Office Worker
steps.content: W-wait, I'm afraid this is too...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Too what? You love this, your favorites folder is full of this kind of "material." You've imagined this scene many times, right?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Because you're not honest and didn't follow the island rules, I'm here to guide you... personally...
The unabashed conversation makes people cheer, and almost all the guests gather here, staring at the island owner and the guest she is "teaching."

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Don't be shy, your heartbeat doesn't lie. You're clearly happy. Now that your passion is ignited, you must enjoy every bit of it.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Now, I'll help you remove the last restraint...

L.L. waves her hand, and a rustling sound comes from the water. Something come to him through the water, gently wrapping its soft limbs around his body, probing into his clothes. The mucus it secretes dissolves the buttons one by one, revealing his wet, sticky, and red-marked naked chest, amid the crowd's increasingly loud cheers.

More and more people gather, those in the back stand on tiptoe or have taller staff lift them up. Some take out binoculars, some cover their eyes but peek through their fingers. Everyone stretches their necks, afraid of missing any part of the scene.

steps.speaker: Skinny Office Worker
steps.content: Ah... not there!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Nuh-uh! Just a little more... shame is not something you need here.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hmm... almost there, it's almost done... Let me see what you truly desire...

A cute manta ray swims through the air, leaving behind white light and blue sparkling particles. As his clothes dissolve almost completely, the man suddenly turns muscular, his upper body forming a perfect V-shape, even showing signs of further development, making his head look smaller in comparison.
The soft creature slides its limbs down his body, as if reluctant to leave. People's gazes follow its movement, admiring the perfect physique.

steps.speaker: Muscular Hunk (New)
steps.content: This, this is?!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Your computer desktop is always filled with such photos. You've always wanted a body like this, right?
The guest was left shocked, repeatedly feeling his body, looking at L.L. in disbelief.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: These past few years, you've been working out every day, torturing yourself with tasteless chicken breasts, vegetable salads, and those yucky protein powders. Now that you're in Elysiland, you don't have to work so hard!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: And of course, there's more!
With a clap of her hands, the electronic pet named Manty swims past everyone again, and several voluptuous beauties and handsome men suddenly appear among the crowd.
Seeing these instantly realized wishes, the guests scream and cheer excitedly, touching their bodies with admiration, praises filling the air.

steps.speaker: Muscular Hunk (New)
steps.content: Sob, it's... it's so wonderful, so incredible! Yes, I could never admit it, but... this is what I've always wanted.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Why feel ashamed? Who told you this is shameful?
L.L. looks at the muscular man's aggrieved expression, then turns to the onlookers. She flashes a knowing smile before bending down to gently pat the man's face.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: If you care about what others say to you that much... well, then listen close to what I am about to say...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Here and now, in Elysiland, stop caring about everything else except yourself.

steps.speaker: L.L.s
steps.content: The same goes for all of you!

In an instant, countless L.L.s appear among the crowd, some lifting guests' chins, some gently hooking their pinkies, enticing them to reveal their innermost desires. Suddenly, the island is filled with exclamations, as all the spectators are pulled into their own "dreams come true."

steps.speaker: L.L.s
steps.content: I know... in reality, you're used to caring about others' opinions, used to following the rules. You have to be cautious and avoid traps; you fear losing yourself, and the consequences of acting on your desires.

steps.speaker: L.L.s
steps.content: But here in Elysiland, you are truly free. Anything you want can come true, anything you want to do is allowed.

steps.speaker: L.L.s
steps.content: The things you dare not say or think about, the bad, shameful, misunderstood ideas in your head! Elysiland will make them all come true for you.

steps.speaker: L.L.s
steps.content: ...Only here, only for today. Everyone has only one chance, so think carefully.

steps.speaker: L.L.s
steps.content: Don't worry about anything beyond the here and now. Is such precious time meant to be wasted on others? Do you have to worry about things that haven't happened yet? Why not look at your own heart first?

steps.speaker: L.L.s
steps.content: Ask yourself what you are looking forward to, what makes your heart race and blood boil?

steps.speaker: L.L.s
steps.content: Think about it! Since you've all accepted my invitation and come to Elysiland, be honest! Everyone can and should realize those wonderful wishes!

steps.speaker: Muscular Hunk (New)
steps.content: I... I want a beautiful body... I want to show my beautiful body... I...

steps.speaker: Excited Female Guest
steps.content: Bring on the handsome guys! I want a guy like Liam from "My Dear Coroner"! I want him here with me now! Eeeeeeeei!
Before she finishes, a more urgent shout comes from the crowd.

steps.speaker: Excited Male Guest
steps.content: Then I want a beauty to play games with me!

steps.speaker: Excited Male Guest
steps.content: Or a catgirl maid! One who can cook, warm the bed, and play online games with me!!! If you really have such great ability, give her to me, satisfy me first!!!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hahaha, no problem! That's the spirit! I'll satisfy you all!
Colorful ribbons rain down with L.L.'s voice as exciting music begins to play.

Restaurants, docks, bizarre decorations... buildings and amusement facilities rise from the ground. Pretty girls, handsome guys, magical animals suddenly appear. And many more "desires" are fulfilled.
In an instant, the island transforms into its true form, becoming Elysiland.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: This is not reality. Those hurt, exhausting, and embarrassing feelings don't belong here. Elysiland only wants your happiness!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Forget sadness, forget pain, forget shame! Face your desires! Grow your desires!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Be honest with yourself, indulge in yourself! Squeeze every second of today here and now, make it unforgettable for a lifetime!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: This is the only rule of Elysiland, my only command to you!
Her words kindle Elysiland, the crowd boils, and the carnival begins.
The girl who makes all this happen leaps into the air, dispersing into the azure sky, while at the other end of the island—

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...My only command to you! ...Ahh!
A huge splash erupts from the enormous luxury pool, as a figure crashes heavily into the water.

At the other end of the island, a giant boat that contains a pool anchors in a concealed corner of the beach. The one who just fell in is L.L., who got too excited during her welcome speech and accidentally leaped out of the water.
Being out of the water for so long overstimulates her body, she can't hold on and falls straight down. Manty quickly swims to the poolside, looking for its master underwater.
After a while, ripples appear on the pool's surface, and L.L. emerges with half her head, blowing bubbles and complaining, her expression somewhat embarrassed.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Blub blub blub? (Are you laughing at me?)

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Blub blub blub blub blub blub? (I tried so hard that I got exhausted. How could you?)
Manty shakes its head vigorously, trying to explain, but gets drenched by the water the girl splashes.
L.L.'s face no longer shows any anger, she giggles and laughs heartily.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Oh come on, laugh if you want to. Why worry about making me unhappy? Be yourself on the island.
She floats leisurely in the water to the other side, leaning against the window, watching the joyful figures on the beach not far away, her eyes gleaming.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Ah... such pure and lovely newcomers. It's a pity I can only stay here now, I can't join them in there yet, it's not time...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: So Manty, you go, transform into me. Every strand of hair must be perfectly replicated. I need you to find the lonely guests who aren't quite prepared for this place yet. Oh! Make sure you pay a visit to those who are having a lot of fun too!

Manty receives the order, circles in front of the girl, and projects a hologram identical to her. This hologram replicates into countless girls, giggling as they fall backward, passing through the huge floor-to-ceiling windows, floating toward everyone on the beach.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: With so many people here, let me have some fun too!
